overview.allGood: The advisor's rules found nothing to fix.

overview.empty.title: No sessions in this period yet
overview.empty.body: Quipu collects Claude Code transcripts in the background. Work in Claude Code, or pick a longer period.
khipu.label: Khipu of your projects
khipu.legend: Each cord is a project. Colour and length show cache writes, and the knots record the number the way Inca khipus did: thousands, hundreds, tens and units of {unit} tokens from top to bottom. A red side cord marks things worth fixing; its knot counts them.
khipu.more: Showing {shown} of {total} projects, those with the most cache writes; the rest are in the list below.
stat.cacheWritesNote: what uses up your limits most
stat.missesNote: with a reason from the API
finding.applyNote: Quipu keeps a copy before changing the file; undo it from Advice.
finding.manual: This one needs a manual edit: it takes your judgement.
rule.large-import.title: @{ref} adds ≈ {tokens} tokens to every session
rule.large-import.detail: An @import loads the whole file at the start of every session, even when the task does not need it. Mention it in plain text and say when to read it; Claude opens it when it is needed.

rule.claude-ai-skills.title.one: {count} skill from claude.ai adds ≈ {tokens} tokens to every session
rule.claude-ai-skills.title.other: {count} skills from claude.ai add ≈ {tokens} tokens to every session

rule.claude-ai-skills.detail: These skills are synced from claude.ai and listed in every session of every project: {names}. The change hides them from the model; they stay available as /name. To stop syncing them entirely, set "syncClaudeAiSkills": false.
rule.long-claude-md.title: {name} has {lines} lines (recommended up to {limit})
rule.long-claude-md.detail: The whole file is sent with every request. Move topic-specific rules to .claude/rules/*.md with paths:, and step-by-step procedures to skills.
rule.memory-limit.title.over: MEMORY.md has {lines} lines; only the first {limit} are loaded
rule.memory-limit.title: MEMORY.md is nearly full
rule.memory-limit.detail.over: Claude does not see entries past the limit. Merge similar ones and remove stale ones.
rule.memory-limit.detail.near: New entries will soon be cut off. Merge similar ones and remove stale ones.
project.startTitle: What is sent at the start of a session
project.alwaysNote: These files and descriptions go into every request.
project.onDemandNote: Loaded only when Claude touches matching files or invokes a skill.
context.aria: Session start: Claude Code {claude}, your files {files}
advice.title: Advice
advice.subtitle: What to change so Claude Code sends less that it does not need
advice.userNote: One change applies to every project.
cache.title: Cache and tokens
cache.subtitle: Where your limits go and why the cache misses
cache.missesNote: The API reports these reasons itself, so they are not guesses.
miss.previous_message_not_found: The cache expired after a pause
miss.previous_message_not_found.tip: After a long break, start a new session or /clear instead of continuing the old one.
miss.messages_changed: Part of the conversation already sent changed
miss.messages_changed.tip: Happens after /compact or when earlier messages are edited.
miss.system_changed.tip: CLAUDE.md, settings or the output style changed mid-session.
miss.tools_changed.tip: An MCP server or plugin was connected or turned off mid-session.
miss.model_changed.tip: Pick the model at the start of a session: switching resets the cache.
profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.subtitle: Separate Claude accounts, such as personal and work, and which folders run under which
profiles.name: Name
profiles.nameNote: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. The profile lives in ~/.claude-name.
profiles.shareNote: Projects, memory and transcripts are never shared, so personal and work stay apart.
profiles.removeNote: The profile folder with its login and sessions stays on disk; quipu removes only its own links and settings.
rules.title: Which folder uses which profile
rules.note: quipu run starts Claude under the profile of the nearest folder with a rule.
rules.empty: No rules yet: everything runs as default, and quipu run asks.
rules.alias: To make plain claude pick the profile itself, add to ~/.bashrc:
signin.title: Sign in to {name}
signin.why: If the browser is already signed in to claude.ai with another account, the sign-in page just confirms that one. That is why quipu opens it in a private window.
signin.emailNote: Optional: Claude fills it in on the sign-in page.
signin.start: Sign in in a private window
signin.step.open: The sign-in page is ready. If no private window opened, open it one of these ways:
signin.step.wait: Sign in with the right account; this panel updates by itself.
auth.title: Open quipu through its link
auth.body: Only the link with a token can open this page. Run in a terminal:
notFound.title: There is no such page
result.applied: Applied. A copy was saved; open Claude Code sessions see the change after /clear.
result.undone: Undone: the file is back as it was.
result.finding-gone: This finding is gone or cannot be applied automatically. The page was refreshed.
result.file-changed: Not applied: {path} changed after the finding was made. Check it and try again.
result.undo-changed: Not undone: the file was edited after quipu changed it, and undoing would lose that edit.
result.project-unknown: No such project among the collected ones.
result.profile-added: Profile {name} created in {dir}. Now sign in to it.
result.profile-removed: Profile {name} removed. Its folder with the login stays: {dir}
result.folder-not-absolute: Give the full path to the folder, or a path starting with ~/.
result.rule-saved: Claude in {folder} and below now runs as {name}.
result.email-invalid: That does not look like an email address.
result.sign-in-private: The sign-in page opened in a private window: sign in there with the account for {name}.
result.private-window-failed: Could not open a private window: copy the link and paste it into one yourself.
result.unauthorized: No access: open quipu with quipu ui.
